# fancybash — Hyper-Optimized Pure Rust Terminal Suite & CLI Toolkit

> Production-ready, zero-dependency, hyper-optimized pure Rust binary toolkit providing interactive TUI tools, developer utilities, and shell enhancements.

## Core Resources

- [AI Agent Full Specification (AGENT.md)](https://fancybash.netlify.app/AGENT.md): Complete machine-readable documentation, feature list, command reference, and developer guide for AI Agents.
- [Official Website](https://fancybash.netlify.app/): Interactive landing page with theme previews, features, and quick setup instructions.
- [Official Documentation](https://fancybash.netlify.app/docs.html): Comprehensive user manual, keyboard shortcuts, installation troubleshooting, and command reference.
- [Linux Setup Guide](https://fancybash.netlify.app/linux-setup.html): Curated developer software installer for Linux ecosystems.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/rihadjahanopu/fancybash): Source code, issue tracker, release notes, and contribution guidelines.

## Quick Installation

```bash
# One-command installer (Auto-detects OS and architecture):
curl -fsSL https://fancybash.netlify.app/install.sh | bash
```

## Highlights

- ⚡ Hyper-Optimized Pure Rust Architecture (Zero external binary or subshell dependencies)
- 🛡️ 100% Memory Safe with `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` constraints
- 🎨 55 Built-in Interactive Prompt Themes (`fancybash theme`)
- 📦 Parallel Fast Archive Compressor & Extractor (`compressor`, `extractor`)
- 🎬 FFmedia 24-in-1 Multimedia Suite (`ffmedia`)
- 🔐 Encrypted Vault & Decoy Security Suite (`vault`)
- 🛠️ Interactive TUI Utilities built with Ratatui (`todo`, `notes`, `filetree`, `process_manager`)
- 🐳 Universal Package & Tool Manager (`pkg_converter`, `system_clean`, `updater`)
